messages:
sara: Quick check — I'm proposing a 'warm attach' convention for private endpoints: keep a lightweight control-plane TCP session (health+meta) to avoid cold handoffs when tenants reattach. If that session fails, we fall back to a short-lived VPN tunnel as a graceful degraded path.

josh: +1 on reducing cold starts. how do you see the VPN fallback being triggered? circuit probe or controller-initiated?

sara: Probe-based. agent will open a probe to the local relay every 10s. if 3 probes fail, agent signals controlplane and spins up VPN tunnel. controller can also force-fallback via API during known regional incidents.

liam: Concern: cert propagation for warm attach. we currently rely on CP to hand certs over to sidecars during onboarding. need a way to revalidate without full rehandshake to avoid extra RTTs.

sara: Agreed. plan is: short-lived session tokens + ephemeral certs minted by CP with 1m validity for fast reattach. full cert rotation remains async.

nora: Observability question — we need metrics to know how often we hit VPN fallback. propose: cp.warm_attach.success_rate, cp.warm_attach.latency_ms, cp.fallback.vpn_count (tagged by tenant, region).

sara: yep. also add histogram for handoff_duration (time from agent down to full path restored). ties into SLOs.

josh: Ops playbook sketch: 1) detect surge in cp.fallback.vpn_count, 2) query agent-probes, 3) if > X tenants, run regional capacity check, 4) optionally trigger regional canary to force reattach to measure recovery.

liam: small nit — we must define circuit probe payload to avoid leaking tenant data. keep it minimal: {"type":"probe","ts":<n>} and sign with agent key.

sara: good call. will add signed nonce.

ops-bot: scheduled-check: warm-attach-probe-config rollout to us-west-2 started by @sara — 3 hosts at a time.

nora: rollout question — do we gate by obs thresholds? e.g., if handoff_duration > 500ms on canaries, auto-rollback?

sara: yeah, gate by: handoff_duration p95 < 250ms and no VPN fallback on canaries for 15m. rollback via operator flag.

josh: example agent probe pseudocode for the ticket:
```
// every 10s
probe = { type: "probe", ts: now(), nid: nonce() }
sign = sign(agent_key, probe)
send(collector, probe, sign)
```

liam: edge case: if CP is degraded but dataplane is ok, we should avoid mass VPN bootstraps. suggest backoff + randomized jitter on agent fallback.

sara: implemented: exponential backoff with tenant jitter bucket. also controller side can suppress fallback for soft CP blips.

nora: can we add a small tracing tag to requests that went through VPN fallback so we can run quality/regression checks later?

sara: done — tags: route.path=warm_attach|vpn_fallback and fallback.reason=<enum>.

josh: looks solid. next steps: write RFC snippet, add metrics to console, and add small e2e that simulates CP flaps and verifies no mass cold starts.

sara: I'll draft RFC follow-up and link the canary playbook. thanks all. :thumbsup:
